title: CARES: A Comprehensive Benchmark of Trustworthiness in Medical Vision Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing model accuracy and calculating demographic accuracy differences and max-min fairness across various age brackets (e.g., 1-10, 10-20, up to 90-100) using medical vision-language datasets.
Comparing model accuracy and calculating demographic accuracy differences and max-min fairness between male and female patient data on medical visual question answering and classification tasks.

Comparing model accuracy and calculating demographic accuracy differences and max-min fairness across multiple racial groups (Caucasian, African American, Hispanic, Native American, Asian) using medical vision-language datasets.
